items.purpose: In the nature of a substitute.

dimensions.assessment: Affects 15 appointed advisory committee members and commercial space industry stakeholders who provide input.
dimensions.evidence: The Committee shall be composed of 15 members appointed by the Secretary.

dimensions.assessment: Advisory body functions provide recommendations and reports rather than binding regulations.
dimensions.evidence: to provide to the Secretary and Congress recommendations on the manner in which the United States may facilitate and promote a safe... commercial sector

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or funding amounts are mentioned in the text.
Creates a temporary federal advisory committee focused on commercial space policy and celestial contamination best practices.
dimensions.evidence: To establish the Commercial Space Activity Advisory Committee, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: The advisory committee is mandated to terminate ten years after establishment.
dimensions.evidence: The Committee shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the date on which the Committee is established.

importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a 15-member advisory committee within the Department of Commerce to provide recommendations on commercial space activities.
